data.name: Moneeza
data.gender_notes: Moneeza is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘nz’, meaning ‘to soften, to be gentle, or to be tender-hearted’. This name is often used to describe a woman of great compassion and gentleness. In Islamic culture, it is also associated with the tender-hearted nature of the Prophet Muhammad’s (pbuh) beloved wife, Aisha (ra). The name Moneeza carries the meaning “Gentle, Tender-hearted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Moneeza usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, tender-hearted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carrier of gentle love and compassion.
data.etymology: Moneeza belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Tender-hearted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Moneeza total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
